**Class** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package. Inherits from [Exception](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.exception).

```csharp
public class PrintException : Exception
```

The exception thrown when a printing operation fails. Base class for all Latiprimere exceptions.

public PrintException(string message, Exception innerException)

**Parameters**

- `message`: The message that describes the error.
- `innerException`: The exception that caused this exception.

## Properties

### NativeErrorCode

```csharp
public int? NativeErrorCode { get; init; }
```

Gets the error code reported by the native print system, such as a Win32 error, an IPP status code or an HTTP status code, or `null` if none applies.
